cases.description: Single exact match — cheapest black UK9 running shoe under a generous budget should resolve deterministically with no AI call.
Multiple UK9 running shoes with no further constraint — several equally-eligible candidates.
Multiple eligible candidates with a stated preference — ranking should favor the preferred attribute where present.
Impossible size in an otherwise real category.
Black UK9 running shoe under a budget nothing in-category satisfies exactly, but a real near match exists.
Same as near-match-budget — verifies the disclosed violation is a BUDGET_MAX, not silently hidden.
Excluding a color must never be relaxed, even when it would be the only near match.
Availability requirement defaults to purchasable-only — an out-of-stock/unknown-inventory variant must not be recommended as confidently available.
